name: Truncated Ellipsoid Primitive
definition: A voxel primitive defined as the intersection of a cube voxel and a fitted bounding ellipsoid, used to model non-uniform intra-voxel geometry distribution and reduce double-counting artifacts in voxel accumulation.
summary: The Truncated Ellipsoid Primitive is a voxel-based volume representation that intersects cubic voxels with fitted ellipsoids to reduce double-counting artifacts and avoid inter-occlusion ambiguity.
